entities.summary: Roberto Esposito is an Italian political philosopher and critical theorist, notable for his contributions to biopolitics, Italian Thought, and metapolitics. He currently serves as emeritus professor of theoretical philosophy at the Scuola Normale Superiore in Pisa.
